integrity: All symbolic identities were regenerated by the included checker; no external independent certification or audit is claimed. The new contribution is the source-to-branch moduli correspondence and its ramification classification, not the already published coordinate branch polynomial or modular formula.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic zero only; the source quartic must be squarefree, and its branch quartic is nonreduced at j=1728. The modular identification is of rational covers only, not a natural isogeny. Established polar branch equations and the classical X0(3) formula are credited to prior work; equivalent antecedents in less accessible moduli literature remain possible.
source_ids: SIGMA 2019: Supersingular elliptic curves and moonshine (X0(3) modular Hauptmodul)
title: The degree-four branch-moduli map of binary-quartic polars
